title: Package Booking Composition & OTP Preview
outcome: Customers review one continuous Package dossier with in-place travel dates, Pay Full by default, transparent commercial breakdown, a truthful phone-OTP preview and progressive traveller entry.
actor: Prospective customer evaluating and starting a published NoorPath booking.
modules: Web Package Details composition reuses existing public departure, pricing and operator projections.
Planner authentication boundary remains server-authoritative; VS-37 adds only a non-sending phone OTP preview while SMS is unconfigured.
Traveller persistence and adult eligibility remain unchanged; UI only changes progressive disclosure.
Approved NoorPath Package references and design-system/MASTER.md remain visual authority.
routes: Package Details Available Travel Dates -> sibling /packages/{departureId}.
Package Details -> Pay Full(default), Milestone or Pay Later -> matching pre-booking commitment.
Package Details -> Book now -> /packages/{departureId}/plan with occupancy and paymentMode preserved.
Planner unauthenticated -> phone OTP design preview; no network delivery while provider is absent.
Planner authenticated -> Add traveller -> existing authoritative traveller creation.
acceptance: Available Travel Dates replaces the detached travel-date treatment and supports visible previous/next navigation.
Itinerary and package content follow image/operator facts without the previous three-column gap.
Pay Full is the default and all three payment modes preserve truthful commitment values.
Price Breakdown appears before Book now and shows explicit zero/unpublished discount and unconfirmed airline where authoritative data is absent.
Book now unauthenticated shows phone OTP design without claiming or sending a code before provider setup.
Authenticated traveller cards show names first and Add traveller progressively reveals the eligibility form.
Desktop, mobile, keyboard, focus, target-size, axe, 200-percent-text, reduced-motion and no-horizontal-overflow checks pass.
Product Owner visually accepts screenshots for the exact final SHA before merge.
exclusions: Real SMS/OTP provider configuration or delivery.
Airline/supplier integration or invented route data.
Child/infant pricing, traveller schema changes or database migrations.
